column1: # quote-aware splitting: separators inside quotes are text, but a command
# substitution still runs even when quoted, so it must still split
# uv refuses to install without a virtual environment, so bare `uv pip install` is safe;
# the ways round that refusal are not
# heredocs. `\n` in a case is decoded to a real newline by the runner.
# A heredoc body is only shell to be executed when the heredoc feeds a shell; fed to
# anything else it is inert data (a file being written, a script in another language).
# Observed live 2026-09-03: authoring a doc whose *content* mentioned an install command
# was blocked, because the body was parsed as if it were shell.
# a real install on its own line is still a command, heredoc or not
# the body is kept whenever a shell owns the heredoc, however the shell is spelled —
# these pin the direction the fix must not open
# unterminated heredoc to a non-shell: the shell hands the body to that command, it is
